shadows.name: owned-window
shadows.purpose: Preview equivalent of the shipped soft-shadow raster around owned windows.

shadows.name: selected-glow
shadows.purpose: Marks only the selected card or current decision.

motion.name: state-immediate
motion.purpose: WoW Lua state changes are immediate; clarity does not depend on animation.

breakpoints.name: toggle-two-column
breakpoints.purpose: Toggle groups use two columns at or above this content width.

components.name: Primary Footer Action
components.description: The only filled footer action; the live Lua control chooses black or white label text for contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { --host-accent: #e21f1f; min-width: 54px; height: 28px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.58); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--host-accent); color: #fff; font: 700 14px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .62; }

components.name: Quiet Footer Action
components.description: Owned neutral action for Back and Skip ahead; it never competes with Next.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-width: 54px; height: 28px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(156,161,171,.74); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(48,50,56,.96); color: #f0f2f7; font: 700 14px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(63,66,73,.96); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #e8ebf0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .62; }

components.name: Selected Choice Card
components.description: A compact owned choice surface whose selected state uses the host accent only at its rim and glow.
components.css: .ds-choice-card { --host-accent: #e21f1f; position: relative; display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 240px; min-height: 72px; padding: 8px 11px 26px; text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--host-accent); border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(31,33,38,.94); color: #e8ebf0; box-shadow: 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb,var(--host-accent) 58%,transparent); } .ds-choice-title { font: 700 14px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-choice-caption { color: #abb0b8; font: 700 11px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-choice-badge { position: absolute; bottom: 7px; left: 10px; color: #fff; font: 700 11px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-choice-card:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-choice-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice-card:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Compact Switch Row
components.description: A row, never a card; checked state is visible through knob position and host-accent track color.
components.css: .ds-switch-row { --host-accent: #e21f1f; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 320px; min-height: 38px; padding: 0 8px 0 4px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(156,161,171,.2); background: rgba(255,255,255,.025); color: #e8ebf0; text-align: left; font: 700 12px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-switch { position: relative; flex: 0 0 36px; height: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--host-accent); } .ds-knob { position: absolute; top: 1px; right: 1px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ececef; } .ds-switch-row small { display: block; margin-top: 1px; color: #abb0b8; font-size: 11px; } .ds-switch-row:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.055); } .ds-switch-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-switch-row:active { filter: brightness(.94); } .ds-switch-row:disabled { opacity: .6; }

components.name: Current Chapter
components.description: The current route step uses accent text, a marker, and a faint fill while preserving the chapter label.
components.css: .ds-chapter-current { --host-accent: #e21f1f; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 182px; height: 26px; padding: 0 8px 0 12px; border: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb,var(--host-accent) 8%,transparent); color: var(--host-accent); text-align: left; font: 700 12px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-chapter-marker { width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--host-accent); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 3px #24262b; } .ds-chapter-current:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb,var(--host-accent) 14%,transparent); } .ds-chapter-current:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-chapter-current:active { filter: brightness(.9); }

components.name: Combat Blocker
components.description: An explicit full-surface blocker that leaves the reason readable while finish actions are unavailable.
components.css: .ds-combat-blocker { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 520px; height: 220px; background: rgba(0,0,0,.55); color: #fff; font: 700 18px 'Roboto Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-shadow: 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.9); }

narrative.overview:
Setup is a short route through a familiar Warcraft world, not a stack of generic dialogs. The interface keeps the next decision obvious, ranks information through depth, and lets the host addon supply identity through a restrained accent.

Classic preserves the established compatibility presentation. The two owned skins share one interaction system: The Selection Stage places smoked glass over the active theme or a neutral fantasy fallback; The War Table translates the same hierarchy into dark oak, antique brass, map slate, and an inked route. Neither skin uses faction marks, named places, copied game art, or client-version-dependent chrome.
keyCharacteristics: Mid-tone layered surfaces over owned, dimmed backdrops.
One host accent reserved for selected, current, checked, progress, and primary states.
Compact decisions, explicit status text, and one filled footer action.
Owned assets and controls that render consistently across supported WoW clients.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The host accent means selected, current, checked, progress, or primary; recommendation and decoration stay neutral.

rules.name: The Contrast Chooses the Ink Rule
rules.body: Filled primary labels automatically use whichever of near-black or white gives the stronger contrast against the live host accent.

rules.name: The Plain Words Rule
rules.body: Labels are short, literal, and readable at a 6th-grade level; status never depends on an icon or color alone.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Chapters stay in the left rail, the current decision stays in the main panel, and progress plus completion actions stay in the footer.

rules.name: The Rank Is Depth Rule
rules.body: Brightness, opacity, rim strength, and shadow identify hierarchy; do not flatten every surface or add arbitrary shadows.

dos: Do keep the host accent scarce and semantic.
Do use the shipped Roboto Condensed Bold and owned setup rasters for both owned skins.
Do show recommended, selected, disabled, completed, skipped, reload, and combat states in words.
Do preserve the same content, state model, and control ownership on every supported WoW client.
Do keep The Selection Stage cool and glassy and The War Table warm, tactile, and faction-neutral.
donts: Don't add a second filled primary action, decorative accent wash, or colored card-edge stripe.
Don't turn switches into cards or expand compact setup decisions into dashboard tiles.
Don't depend on Blizzard templates, atlases, arbitrary Unicode, remote assets, or browser behavior for an owned skin.
Don't hide a blocked or disabled reason behind color, opacity, hover, or an icon alone.
Don't let Classic-specific chrome redefine the owned-skin contract.
